text: trouble: Or, labour | the sparks fly upward: Heb. the sons of the burning coal, lift up to fly
and unsearchable: Heb. and there is no search | without number: Heb. till there be no number
cannot perform their enterprise: Or, cannot perform anything
from the scourge of the tongue: Or, when the tongue scourgeth
thy tabernacle shall be in peace: Or, peace is thy tabernacle | sin: Or, err
for thy good: Heb. for thyself
